observes: AUDITD, BM25 (module 07) over 5 one-line documents: a document holding a token of 200 or 400 chars builds and every document is found; 600 or 2,000 chars: bm25_build raises 'RuntimeError: <THROW>' and the index is left without documents (bm25_info {'type':'bm25'}; every ordinary term searches to []); rebuilding a good 5-document index after adding one node with a 600-char token: the rebuild raises <THROW> and all 5 documents are gone from search; bm25_insert and bm25_search with a 600-char token raise <SUBSCRIPT> Tokenize+26 ^BM25Idx("__stop__",...) and leave the index as it was; a 256-char document id builds with a 230-char term, and a 300-char term fails the whole build the same way
